metadata.description: Daughter of Finwë and Indis. She was the only daughter of Finwë by his second wife Indis, and the half-sister of Fëanor. Her name means 'Fair Woman' in Quenya. She had three brothers: Fingolfin, Finarfin, and a younger sister Lalwen. Through her father, she was of the Noldor; through her mother Indis (of the House of Ingwë), she had Vanyarin blood, giving her the characteristic golden hair of the Vanyar.
